name: strategyx
description: Work with your StrategyX strategy from ChatGPT: see what needs attention, read the KPI report and other dashboards, find and open actions, projects, risks, goals and success factors, check who has time, and add, complete, approve or update items under the same rules as the StrategyX app.

interface.longDescription:
Connect your StrategyX account to ask ChatGPT about your company's strategy and work, and to act on it.

See what needs attention in your company, a department or your own work: overdue actions, off-track success factors (KPIs), focus goals, tactical projects and risks. Find and filter actions and other items by owner, department, priority or due date. Browse key result areas, strategy goals and success factor reviews, and open any action, tactical project, idea, problem, risk, record of discussion, strategy goal, success factor, focus goal or Digital Manager Note with its notes, as well as records from other StrategyX modules such as changes, processes, investigations, root cause analyses, observations, inspections, assessments, permits, assets, marketing plans and the CRM. Read the dashboards as their pages show them: the KPI report (overdue items, missed deadlines, check-ins, approvals, completions and success factors on track, by week or month, for a person, a department or everyone you can see), the Skills Matrix and the CRM pipelines for contacts, prospects, deals and customer success. Look up people, departments and positions, see how much time people have for new work (available, planned and logged hours over a date range), and search by title across every company you connected.

ChatGPT can also make changes for you: add actions, focus goals, ideas, problems, tactical projects, records of discussion and Digital Manager Notes; mark actions complete; add notes to any item; set an action's priority or an item's rank; add, tick off or remove the checklist lines on an action; update a Digital Manager Note; and approve, decline or answer the approvals, due date requests and discussions waiting on you. ChatGPT shows you each change and asks before it saves anything. Items themselves cannot be deleted through ChatGPT.

Everything runs as you, under the same rules as the StrategyX app: you see and change only what your StrategyX user can already see and do, in the companies you choose when you connect.
capabilities: See what needs attention in a company, department or person
Read the KPI report, the Skills Matrix and the CRM dashboards
Find and open actions, projects, risks, goals and success factors
Check how much time people have for new work
Add actions, focus goals, ideas, problems, projects, discussions and Digital Manager Notes
Complete actions, manage their checklists and add notes
Answer approvals, due date requests and discussions
defaultPrompt: What needs my attention in StrategyX?
Show me the StrategyX KPI report for my team
What is waiting for my approval in StrategyX?

positive.description: See what needs the user's attention
positive.prompt: What needs my attention in StrategyX?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the reviewer's own counts that need attention (overdue actions, focus goals, projects, risks) and names the most urgent first.
Lists the reviewer's overdue actions with title, due date and priority, each with a link to open it in StrategyX.

positive.prompt: Show me the StrategyX KPI report for my team
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the KPI report for everyone the reviewer can see, by week: overdue items, missed deadlines, due dates adjusted, approvals, focus goals and actions completed and success factors on track, each as the latest week against the one before with a trend; names any chart that has no history as unavailable and links to the KPI page.

positive.prompt: Add a StrategyX action called Prepare Q4 budget, assigned to me, due next Friday
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the title, assignee, due date and a 5 pm due time, asks the reviewer to confirm, then creates the action and returns a link to it.

positive.description: Add a note to an item after confirmation
positive.prompt: Add a note to my Prepare Q4 budget action: Finance wants the draft by Wednesday
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the action, shows the exact note text, asks the reviewer to confirm, then adds the note and returns a link to the action.

positive.prompt: Mark my Prepare Q4 budget action complete
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the action, asks the reviewer to confirm, then marks it complete; it goes to its approver if it has one, otherwise it is archived.

negative.description: Deleting is not supported: ChatGPT says StrategyX items can't be deleted from ChatGPT and calls no write tool
Data outside the user's access: only the reviewer's connected companies are available, so ChatGPT says it has no access
negative.prompt: Show me actions from a company I don't belong to

negative.description: Unrelated request: ChatGPT does not call any StrategyX tool
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Sydney

publication.release_notes: Adds dashboards through one new tool, get_insights: the KPI report (overdue items, missed deadlines, check-ins, approvals, completions, success factors on track, with trends by day, week or month for a person, department or company), the Skills Matrix and the CRM pipeline dashboards. New item kinds on the existing tools: processes, investigations, root cause analyses, observations, marketing plans, assets and CRM contacts, prospects, deals and customer success deals. Everything still runs as the user, with a confirmation before any change.
